tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.sec1Body: By creating an account or using BibleStudy Pro, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
tos.sec2Body: BibleStudy Pro is a personal Bible study tool. You may use it only for lawful purposes. You must not use the app to generate, store, or share content that is illegal, harmful, or violates the rights of others.
tos.sec3Body: The AI chat feature sends your messages to third-party AI providers (OpenRouter and Anthropic Claude) to generate responses. AI-generated content is for study and informational purposes only and does not constitute theological, legal, medical, or professional advice.
tos.sec4Body: AI features consume credits. Credits are non-refundable once used. Subscriptions are billed through Apple In-App Purchase and are subject to Apple's refund policy. We do not process payments directly.
tos.sec5Body: You retain ownership of the flashcards, notes, and study plans you create. By using BibleStudy Pro, you grant us a limited license to store and process your content solely to provide the service to you.
tos.sec6Body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time from Settings → Delete Account.
tos.sec7Body: BibleStudy Pro is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that AI responses will be accurate or complete.
tos.sec8Body:

legal.tosSec1Body: By creating an account or using BibleStudy Pro, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
legal.tosSec2Body: BibleStudy Pro provides digital Bible study tools including flashcard creation, study plans, AI-assisted Scripture analysis, note-taking, and community features. Some features require an active internet connection or study credits.
legal.tosSec3Body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. You agree to provide accurate registration information.
legal.tosSec4Body: Free accounts receive a daily credit allotment. Premium subscriptions provide additional features and higher credit allowances. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing period through your Apple ID settings.
legal.tosSec5Body: AI-generated responses are provided for educational and study purposes. BibleStudy Pro makes no guarantees regarding theological precision or completeness. AI features must not be used to generate harmful, offensive, or inappropriate content.
legal.tosSec6Body: You retain ownership of the study sets, notes, and cards you create. By making a set public, you grant other users a non-exclusive license to view and copy that set for personal study.
legal.tosSec7Body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in abusive behavior, or attempt to circumvent security or usage limits.
legal.tosSec8Body:
Questions about these Terms should be sent to:
